notes: Brigade support areas are always set up inside the AO, never out on the road from Kuwait
A FOB left outside its AO after the AO shrinks is given up the next day and its company pulls inside, instead of holding out alone for days
Automatic AOs build forward FOBs only once their companies are actually inside the AO to hold them, and a base whose companies are already on the road in cannot be taken while it is empty
Brigades driving north from Kuwait to their AO move in convoy and are ambushed less on the way
